tokens.name: spacing/0
tokens.description: Flush stack. Title and caption, or any pair that should sit with no gap.

tokens.name: spacing/1
tokens.description: Smallest positive fine-grid step. Hairline separation inside a very dense control.

tokens.name: spacing/2
tokens.description: Tight fine-grid gap. Labels, subtitles, and badge dots.

tokens.name: spacing/4
tokens.description: Dense fine-grid step. Hint offsets, small-label padding, and gaps inside fields.

tokens.name: spacing/6
tokens.description: Upper fine-grid step. Compact vertical padding on fields and icon buttons.

tokens.name: spacing/8
tokens.description: Base grid step. Default gap and padding inside controls; larger layout steps multiply it.

tokens.name: spacing/10
tokens.description: Short step just above the base. Compact leading inset on a trailing control.

tokens.name: spacing/12
tokens.description: Control inset above the base. Side padding on fields, selects, and compact rows.

tokens.name: spacing/16
tokens.description: Standard content inset. Row padding inside cards, lists, and menus.

tokens.name: spacing/20
tokens.description: In-between layout step. A group gap between row padding and a section gap.

tokens.name: spacing/24
tokens.description: Comfortable group gap. Header side padding, icon frames, and space under a page header.

tokens.name: spacing/32
tokens.description: Group separation inside a region. Larger icon frames and wide gaps in a header.

tokens.name: spacing/36
tokens.description: Off-grid control size. Fixed hit area a control dictates, such as an icon-button frame.

tokens.name: spacing/40
tokens.description: Section rhythm. Gap between form sections, and the usual compact control height.

tokens.name: spacing/48
tokens.description: Large control or media frame. Big icon step and a roomy empty-region measure.

tokens.name: spacing/56
tokens.description: Tall control slot. Reserved width for a check, or a tall option row.

tokens.name: spacing/64
tokens.description: Page-chrome band. Header height, table row height, and the inset at the bottom of a screen.

tokens.name: spacing/72
tokens.description: Coarse step above page chrome. A large fixed frame or a deep region gap.

tokens.name: spacing/80
tokens.description: Deep inset under scrolled content. Breathing room after the last row of a listing.

tokens.name: spacing/88
tokens.description: Large on-grid measure. A deep page gap or a fixed frame above the listing inset.

tokens.name: spacing/96
tokens.description: Large square frame. Media and icon containers above everyday control size.

tokens.name: spacing/120
tokens.description: Wide layout inset. A side reserve that clears a neighboring control.

tokens.name: spacing/160
tokens.description: Large pictogram frame. Empty-state and person artwork above the icon scale.

tokens.name: spacing/224
tokens.description: Oversized layout block. A fixed region above component and icon scale.

tokens.name: spacing/240
tokens.description: Tall empty region. Placeholder height for a card or media frame with nothing inside.

tokens.name: spacing/320
tokens.description: Largest layout step. A page-scale block or a very large fixed frame.

tokens.name: roundings/2
tokens.description: Tightest corner. Small labels and thin markers that should barely soften.

tokens.name: roundings/4
tokens.description: Default control corner. Fields, selects, and other compact inputs.

tokens.name: roundings/6
tokens.description: Softer control corner. Medium labels.

tokens.name: roundings/8
tokens.description: Soft plate corner. Cards, menus, dropdowns, and grouped controls.

tokens.name: roundings/pill
tokens.label: pill
tokens.description: Fully rounded ends. Badges, progress tracks, icon buttons, and chips.

tokens.name: stroke/1
tokens.description: Hairline border. Dividers, cell rules, and the resting edge of a card.

tokens.name: stroke/2
tokens.description: Emphasis border. Focus rings, selected underlines, and a stronger card edge.

tokens.name: stroke/3
tokens.description: Mid-weight stroke. A border between the emphasis ring and a heavy active edge.

tokens.name: stroke/4
tokens.description: Heavy stroke. Active card edge and the large spinner ring.

tokens.name: stroke/8
tokens.description: Heaviest stroke. A bold outline or a thick ring when the heavy step is still too light.
